name: Edge Eloquent Source
subtitle: Official source repository for Edge Eloquent on-device dictation
description: The official Feather and AltStore-compatible repository for Edge Eloquent. Distributes standalone signed or sign-ready IPAs of Edge Eloquent, powered by Google AI Edge runtime for private on-device dictation.

apps.name: Edge Eloquent
apps.subtitle: Minimalist Realtime Dictation powered by Google AI Edge
apps.localizedDescription: Minimalist iOS realtime dictation powered by Google AI Edge runtime. Transcribes locally on-device using multi-model support, performs local filler cleanup, and enhances text via secure text-only Cloudflare processing. Audio never leaves the device.
apps.versionDescription: Initial release with Google AI Edge multi-model dictation, local cleaner, and Cloudflare text enhancer.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required for real-time speech-to-text dictation directly on your device.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial release with Google AI Edge multi-model dictation, local cleaner, and Cloudflare text enhancer.
